packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time classroom review route renders as a black/yellow One Time classroom surface with contained video/details/thread panels on desktop and mobile, without changing classroom APIs, access-code behavior, reply submission, helper behavior, route access, or external-provider behavior.

title: Classroom Review Brand And Layout Cleanup

reasons: Latest classroom-review screenshots show the route still using a pale generic review-app treatment while the authoritative One Time brand is black plus yellow.
Desktop classroom screenshot shows the Today / Live video and descriptive copy competing in one card, with the text area visually colliding with the video thumbnail/player.
The fix can be scoped to presentation and layout inside the classroom review page without changing classroom data, access-code, helper, reply, moderation, route, or external provider behavior.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Real Google Classroom, Vimeo, Zoom, Drive, email, payment, access-grant, and external-provider writes are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this classroom review cleanup, continue screenshot-reviewed IA/nav/filter cleanup or CRM contact-detail polish.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time classroom route feel clean, even, and correctly branded by replacing the generic pale review-page styling with a contained One Time black/yellow classroom layout and fixing the video/details card so it loads neatly.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No classroom API, review-mode data API, access-code validation, reply submission, helper API, moderation API, route registry, auth, entitlement, payment, access grant, send, or external-provider behavior change.
No Google Classroom, Google Calendar, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, email, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Stripe/payment, DNS, account mutation, upload, publish, or external CRM write.
No GHL runtime or LeadConnector reference.
No raw private member, student, parent, provider, classroom reply, token, secret, or contact evidence.

inspection_targets: public/one-time-classroom.html inline styles and renderToday markup
public/css/one-time-shared-review.css shared One Time review overrides
config/brands/one-time.json committed One Time palette and asset paths
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: Classroom review body and panels render as pale generic cards instead of a One Time black/yellow classroom surface.
Desktop Today / Live card puts a video/player and text in a cramped side-by-side layout where copy visually competes with the media.
Thread/reply areas use pale yellow review styling that is not aligned with the updated One Time dark member surfaces.

expanded_phrases.clean: The classroom route should read as a polished One Time learning surface, not a leftover generic review page.
expanded_phrases.even: Hero, access panel, content panels, video block, calendar, curriculum, participation, questions, threads, and reply form should share black/yellow One Time colors, spacing, and readable card structure.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first loaded classroom screenshots should show contained media/details and no text/video overlap or horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, or mobile.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The route remains a first-party One Time classroom/member review surface scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time classroom review/member classroom route so it uses the One Time black/yellow brand and its video, details, and reply panels are contained/readable on desktop and mobile.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a dark One Time classroom surface with yellow primary actions, readable panels, non-overlapping video/details layout, and contained Rabbi Threads reply form.
acceptance_criteria: The classroom route uses One Time black/yellow/white/muted styling and no longer reads as a pale generic review app.
The Today / Live media and lesson details are arranged so text never overlays or visually collides with the video/player/thumbnail on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
Hero, access panel, content panels, item cards, details, participation rows, thread messages, response form, inputs, and buttons are readable with no horizontal overflow.
Review-only and no-write copy remains visible for test review mode.
Classroom access-code loading, review-mode API path, member API path, reply submission, helper mounting, nav links, route access, and external-provider behavior remain unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Brand memory and design reference confirm One Time is black/yellow.
Current screenshots show the classroom route using generic pale styling and a fragile desktop Today / Live layout.
The likely fix is scoped to classroom review markup/CSS only.
No member data, auth, send, payment, access, credential, privacy, legal, or financial decision is required for local visual implementation.
